title: Faraday induced EMF
references: Griffiths, D. J., Introduction to Electrodynamics, 4th ed., Cambridge University Press (2017)
Jackson, J. D., Classical Electrodynamics, 3rd ed., Wiley (1999)
validity_domain: Magnitude of the EMF induced in a coil of n_turns turns of area `area`, fixed and perpendicular to a uniform field whose magnitude changes by dB at a constant rate over a time dt.
limitations: Fixed loop, uniform field perpendicular to the loop, constant rate of change: an average EMF over dt otherwise
Magnitude only: the sign (Lenz's law) is not decided
A moving or rotating loop, or a field not perpendicular to the loop, needs the flux derivative in general
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty

variables.n_turns: Number of turns of the coil
